title: Launch ops pocket journal - hotfix 1.12.3
content:
Purpose: personal quick-run checklist for shipping hotfix 1.12.3 (inference-proxy crash on long prompts). Not meant as canonical runbook — lean, command-first, things I always forget.

Context:
- Hotfix: inference-proxy bug triggered by input length > 32k tokens with kv-cache eviction. Patch in PR 1987.
- Target window: 03/12 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic).
- Primary stack: hosted-api (edge routing) -> inference-proxy (k8s) -> serving-runtime (gRPC model workers).

Preflight (T-24h -> T-1h) — quick checks I run
- [ ] Confirm CI green and smoke tests pass on PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1987
- [ ] Backport branches created: rel/1.12 and rel/1.12-hotfix-1.12.3
- [ ] Canary artifacts built and pushed: container tag = pr-1987-20260311-1
- [ ] Postgres schema untouched (no migration) — skip DB migration window
- [ ] Inform #releases with one-line plan + rollback criteria (see comms templates below)
- [ ] Pager duty: rotation assigned (Marco primary, Sienna backup)

Cutover quick timeline (my personal minute-by-minute plan)
- T-30m: final smoke on canary image in staging (small model)
  - command: kubectl -n staging set image deploy/inference-proxy inference-proxy=ghcr.io/redwood/pr-1987-20260311-1
  - smoke: python tests/smoke_long_prompt.py --host staging-proxy:8080
- T-15m: push canary to prod subset (5% traffic via routing policy)
  - console: apply route weight: inference-proxy-v2 = 5%
  - verify latency and error rates for 10m
- T+10m: if no errors and 95th% latency within SLO, expand to 30%
- T+30m: full rollout if stable; otherwise rollback to previous tag and open revert PR

Command cheatsheet (copy-paste friendly)
- deploy new image to prod k8s: kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-proxy inference-proxy=ghcr.io/redwood/pr-1987-20260311-1 --record
- route weight: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \"https://console.redwood.ai/api/routes/inference-proxy/weights\" -d '{\"weights\": {\"v2\": 0.05}}'
- tail logs: stern inference-proxy -n prod --since 10m | rg 'ERROR|panic|exception'
- quick health check: curl -sS https://proxy.redwood.ai/health | jq .
- revert image: kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-proxy inference-proxy=ghcr.io/redwood/inference-proxy:1.12.2 --record

Rollback criteria (what makes me abort and revert immediately)
- sustained 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5 minutes
- 95th percentile latency increase > 2x baseline for 10 minutes
- memory OOMs observed on more than one pod in 10 minutes
- synthetic long-prompt smoke failures reproduce consistently on canary

Backports & kube resources to check
- Backports: rel/1.12-hotfix-1.12.3 -> rel/1.12 -> master (merge order after release)
- K8s: verify HPA min/max, look for pod churn: kubectl get hpa -n prod; kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-proxy -o wide
- Node pressure: kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr

Comms templates (paste into Slack or status)
- Pre-rollout (to #releases): \"Starting hotfix rollout 1.12.3 for inference-proxy at 02:00 UTC. Canary 5% -> 30% -> 100% if metrics stable. Pager: Marco (primary), Sienna (backup). Rollback criteria: 5xx>0.5% or 95p latency > 2x. Will update after canary check in ~15m.\"
- Rollout success: \"Hotfix 1.12.3 fully rolled out at 02:42 UTC. No regressions observed on canary or 30% window. Monitoring OK. Will keep elevated watch for 2 hours.\"
- Rollback notice: \"Aborting rollout for 1.12.3 at 02:18 UTC — observed error spike and OOMs. Reverting to tag 1.12.2. Investigating root cause. Will follow up with incident notes.\"

Post-roll steps (my personal checklist)
- [ ] Create short postmortem if rollback or any customer-facing errors occurred (link to template: confluence/rel/pm-template)
- [ ] Merge backports and update CHANGELOG for 1.12.3
- [ ] Update monitoring alert thresholds if needed (eng-observability)
- [ ] Schedule follow-up investigation session with SRE + Serving team if OOMs or latency regressions

Stupid mistakes I make (reminders to self)
- \"Did I update the routing policy or did I update the deployment?\" — always confirm two things: image tag AND route weight after deploying.
- Remember to unset canary weight if failure (I sometimes forget and leave 5% in prod)
- If rolling back, give it 2 minutes after revert before scaling decisions — let pods stabilize

Open questions / TODOs (for later)
- Does the kv-cache eviction threshold need to be tuned per-model? (ask Priya)
- Add a synthetic long-prompt test to our CI so this doesn't slip through again (ticket: RELENG-549)
- Explore adding per-request token-count gating in the proxy (low priority)

Notes for writeup (2-3 lines I can paste into release notes)
- \"Fix: proxy crash when handling >32k token requests by guarding kv-cache eviction logic. Backported to 1.12. Includes additional smoke for long prompts.\"

End-of-run personal log (timestamps I jot here during cutover)
- 02:00 - launched canary 5% (OK)
- 02:12 - expanded to 30% (latency slightly up, within threshold)
- 02:42 - full rollout completed, monitoring nominal

If something goes sideways: pager flow (who to ping)
- Pager -> Marco (primary) -> Sienna -> Ops manager (on-call infra) -> Eng PM on duty

Random snippets I wrote because I forget them:
- If a model worker is OOMing, check worker args for max_sequence and set to 65k to be safe for prod (temporary).
- Keep an eye on KV cache miss ratio metric: inference.kvcache.miss_rate

-- end of scratchpad --

(Will trim and move canonical steps into releng runbooks after the hotfix ships.)
